# Westport Family Homes

> Westport Family Homes designs and builds new-construction homes in Westport and Fairfield County, Connecticut. Owner and builder David Popkin has lived in Westport for more than 30 years and has been building homes there for 18 years. The company has won four HOBI Awards from the Home Building Industry Association of Connecticut. Its current home for sale is 5 Baldwin Place: 2.3 acres, 6 bedrooms, a saltwater pool, room for a tennis or pickleball court, and an accessory dwelling unit.

## Contact

- Owner and builder: David Popkin, WestportFHLLC@gmail.com, 203-856-7678
- Real estate broker: Lori Popkin, Coldwell Banker, lori.popkin@cbmoves.com, 203-984-7677
